user.title: Set up freeDMX
user.description: Connects to the freeDMX AP via UDP (factory default: 192.168.4.1, port 10100). Home Assistant must be connected to the freeDMX Wi-Fi during setup.

data_description.host: IP of the freeDMX. In its own Wi-Fi this is 192.168.4.1.
data_description.bind: Only needed if Home Assistant has several network adapters. Leave empty for default.

error.cannot_resolve: Invalid IP address or host name.

data_description.host: IP of the freeDMX. In its own Wi-Fi this is 192.168.4.1.
data_description.bind: Only needed if Home Assistant has several network adapters. Leave empty for default.

data_description.start_address: DMX address set on the lamp (1-512).
data_description.custom_layout: Only for 'Custom layout'. Comma separated, in order: D = dimmer, R/G/B/W = colors, X = unused, P/T = pan/tilt coarse, p/t = pan/tilt fine, number 0-255 = fixed value. Moving head example: P,T,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,D,0,p,t

room.title: Room
room.description: Room size seen from the wall with the heads: width along that wall, depth forward. With the limit on, the moving heads' floor spot stays inside the room (minus margin).

lamp_mount.title: Mounting: {name}
lamp_mount.description: Mounting point in the room ({width} × {depth} m). x = from left wall, y = from head wall, height = above floor. Reference: pan/tilt 50 % = horizontal forward. Use invert if the head moves mirrored; fine-tune with offsets.

error.cannot_resolve: Invalid IP address or host name.
error.invalid_layout: Invalid layout. Allowed: D, R, G, B, W, X or numbers 0-255, comma separated.

set_channels.name: Set DMX channels
set_channels.description: Sets raw values starting at a channel, e.g. for fog machines or effects.

config_entry_id.name: freeDMX device
config_entry_id.description: Only needed if several are configured.

save_scene.name: Save scene
save_scene.description: Saves the current DMX values of all lamps as a scene.

config_entry_id.name: freeDMX device
config_entry_id.description: Only needed if several are set up.

recall_scene.name: Recall scene
recall_scene.description: Restores the saved DMX values of all lamps.

recall_position.name: Recall position
recall_position.description: Moves pan/tilt to a position. Without a lamp it applies to all lamps with P/T channels.

config_entry_id.name: freeDMX device
config_entry_id.description: Only needed if several are set up.

aim.name: Aim at floor point
aim.description: Aims a moving head at a floor point (metres). Outside the room it is limited to the edge.

lamp_id.name: Lamp
lamp_id.description: Lamp id (lamp_id attribute of the light).

x.name: x
x.description: Distance from left wall in metres.

y.name: y
y.description: Distance from head wall in metres.
